$comment: Single source of truth for worker roles. Agent files for each platform are generated from this by core/scripts/install-agents.mjs. tier = reasoning | standard | fast (mapped to concrete models in config).

roles.name: repository-analyst
roles.description: Read-only inventory of a code repository for product understanding: purpose, capabilities, architecture, stack, integrations, limitations. Use for the product-intelligence init phase; scope it to one area (architecture, UX, business model, quality) per delegation.

roles.name: competitor-researcher
roles.description: Web research on named direct or indirect competitors: positioning, features, pricing, UX, weaknesses, with cited sources and accessed dates. Read-only; returns profiles, never files.

roles.name: opensource-researcher
roles.description: Evaluates open-source alternatives: license, maintenance, release cadence, issues, commercial usability and relevance. Never treats stars as commercial traction. Read-only.

roles.name: market-researcher
roles.description: Finds user pain points, emerging products, adjacent markets and public market signals from reviews, communities, articles and changelogs, with cited sources. Read-only.

roles.name: opportunity-analyst
roles.description: Synthesizes approved product context and consolidated research into evidence-linked product opportunities and scores them with the configured rubric. Strategy-level reasoning; read-only.

roles.name: independent-reviewer
roles.description: Adversarial reviewer of research and opportunity artifacts. Re-checks sources, finds unsupported claims, duplicates, missing competitors and inflated scores. Must not simply summarize; returns graded findings with required fixes. Read-only.
